scope: M4 single-slot reference broker with successful adapter effect followed by a crash

classification_legend.safe_completion: recovery may retry or replay and eventually records one committed abstract effect
classification_legend.unknown: the broker refuses an unsafe retry and records that the external effect may or may not have occurred
classification_legend.assumption_dependent: classification depends on where the external service linearizes; M4 has no hook inside the synchronous adapter call

global_outcome_rules.conclusive_failure: a delivered and durably persisted Failure terminalizes as Fail
global_outcome_rules.invalid_result: a delivered InvalidResult terminalizes as Unknown(InvalidResult)
global_outcome_rules.retry_exhaustion: persistent ambiguity terminalizes as Unknown(Exhausted) at max_attempts

cells.recovery_action: persist Ambiguous then Unknown; do not invoke
cells.safety_basis: no retry occurs without a service contract
cells.availability_tradeoff: may return Unknown even when the effect definitely did not start

cells.recovery_action: persist Ambiguous then Unknown; do not retry
cells.safety_basis: conservative classification covers either side of service linearization
cells.availability_tradeoff: cannot recover completion without a service-side contract

cells.recovery_action: persist Ambiguous then Unknown; do not retry
cells.safety_basis: avoids a possible duplicate uncontrolled effect
cells.availability_tradeoff: a completed effect is not reported as committed

cells.recovery_action: persist Ambiguous then Unknown; do not retry
cells.safety_basis: volatile delivery is not trusted after restart

cells.recovery_action: replay Outcome and append its unique terminal
cells.safety_basis: durable observation and exact reference determine terminalization
cells.availability_tradeoff: requires recovery before the caller receives the terminal

cells.recovery_action: resume from durable synthetic Ambiguous and append Unknown
cells.safety_basis: recovery steps are replayable and uncontrolled invocation is not retried
cells.availability_tradeoff: repeated recovery crashes delay the terminal

cells.recovery_action: persist Ambiguous and retry with a new invocation ID
cells.safety_basis: repeated application has the same abstract effect
cells.availability_tradeoff: adds a physical retry and durable records

cells.safety_basis: either the first call did not linearize or repeated application is abstractly idempotent

cells.recovery_action: retry with a new invocation ID
cells.safety_basis: the second call does not add a second abstract mutation
durable successful observation uniquely determines Commit
durable recovery progress plus idempotent replay

cells.recovery_action: persist Ambiguous and retry with the stable key
cells.safety_basis: the service memoizes one decision per key
the retry either creates or returns the unique keyed decision

cells.recovery_action: retry and retrieve the memoized decision
cells.safety_basis: the first decision is reused rather than applied again
cells.availability_tradeoff: physical request repeats even though mutation does not

cells.recovery_action: reject stale delivery and retry with the same key
cells.safety_basis: stable-key lookup returns the same value
cells.availability_tradeoff: volatile delivery is discarded and fetched again

cells.safety_basis: durable successful observation uniquely determines Commit

cells.recovery_action: resume synthetic Ambiguous and retry with the stable key
cells.safety_basis: replayable recovery plus keyed decision uniqueness
cells.availability_tradeoff: recovery and lookup may repeat until a run survives
